data.name: Bahira
data.gender_notes: Bahira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-h-r', meaning 'to shine, to brighten, to bring light'. The name Bahira is a feminine form, meaning 'Light of God'. The name Bahira carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahira usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'bahirah', meaning 'illuminated'. In Islamic tradition, Bahira is believed to symbolize the inner light that guides individuals towards the truth and the right path.
data.etymology: Bahira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahira total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
